description: This file defines the Metadata class and related nested classes for managing status information, services, channels, servers, subsystems, and RPC configurations within the Thunder PluginHost namespace. It includes class definitions, methods, and external references related to plugin metadata and system status.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Main class holding system status, plugin, channel, bridge, server, subsystem, and RPC information, with nested classes for Service, Channel, Server, SubSystem, and COMRPC.

classes.name: Metadata::Service
classes.description: Represents a plugin service with state, version, module, observers, and interface versions.

classes.name: Metadata::Channel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel with remote endpoint, state, activity status, ID, and name.

classes.name: Metadata::Server
classes.description: Contains server minion info, thread pool runs, and pending requests.

classes.name: Metadata::Minion
classes.description: Represents a minion process with ID, job, and run count.

classes.name: Metadata::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystems with add and clear functionalities.

classes.name: Metadata::COMRPC
classes.description: Holds remote link and proxy data for RPC communication.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for plugin metadata, including instance ID and subsystem precondition, termination, and control lists.

classes.name: MetadataType
classes.description: Template class implementing IMetadata, providing plugin versioning and subsystem requirements.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Template class for creating plugin metadata services, extending Core::PublishedServiceType.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for nested classes, often deleted or defaulted.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets internal JSON arrays and objects to empty states.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a subsystem to the SubSystem collection.

methods.name: InstanceId
methods.description: Converts pointers or non-pointers to Core::instance_id.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Converts Core::instance_id back to thread ID types.
